note: B25 Office de tourisme (the globe office) on the Carrefour des Voyages, camera on the cobbles of the square facing the facade. Cream stone house with blue shutters, terracotta roof with a dormer (the globe attic), a big painted globe on a wrought-iron bracket with a blank name plaque, a compass-rose drainpipe bracket and a world-map doormat; the same building as in S08_sector (left of the station) and in B22_hotel (right). Painted 2026-10-22 (picked from the s08p2 draft b25_ext_a, track s08p3).
